title: M5 — Validate a dependable daily-use assistant
description: Review the vertical slice against real representative requests and controlled failure scenarios. Define reliability through observable outcomes rather than a vague claim of autonomy. Expand the product only after this gate.
why: A successful demo is not enough to trust recurring delegated work.

acceptance.text: The agreed acceptance scenarios pass with recorded evidence

outcome.summary: M5 gate: automated acceptance + evidence doc; user pilot rows optional.
